rationale.q1: Exposure groups drawn from the same prospective MCCS cohort recruited in 1990–1994; common eligibility rules.
rationale.q2: All participants completed the same baseline 121-item FFQ, with separate regular and diet soft drink questions.
rationale.q3: Discussion explicitly states soft drink measures were self-reported and were not specifically validated.
rationale.q4: Potential confounders identified using a directed acyclic graph; socioeconomic status, alcohol, country of birth, diet, activity, sex and smoking stated.
rationale.q5: Multivariable Cox models adjust specified confounders; ASB additionally adjusts SSB and waist circumference; sensitivity analyses evaluate alternatives.
rationale.q6: Baseline cancer history excluded before follow-up.
rationale.q7: Incident invasive/metastatic primary cancers identified through Victorian Cancer Registry or Australian Cancer Database.
rationale.q8: Baseline 1990–1994 through 30 June 2013 is sufficient duration; end of follow-up explicitly stated.
rationale.q9: Death and last known presence in Australia are censoring events; proportion lost to cancer follow-up and reasons are not enumerated.
rationale.q10: Censoring is described; no explicit assessment or weighting for differential incomplete follow-up reported.
rationale.q11: Cox models use age as time scale; Schoenfeld residual checks and sex stratification address proportional hazards; site-specific category contrasts and CIs reported.

record.poolability_reason: Male site-specific analytic N unavailable; global N=35,593 includes women and must not be substituted.
